audit_items.proof_trace: TOCTOU race condition: SidecarParentValid checks hasBadBlock cache while parent block validation runs asynchronously in subscriber_beacon_blocks.go. Data column can pass validation during the window between parent block failing validation and setBadBlock updating the cache, violating the invariant that sidecars with invalid parents must be rejected.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker sends invalid block B and data column sidecar C (referencing B) simultaneously via P2P. Block B fails validation asynchronously while sidecar C's SidecarParentValid check executes, reading hasBadBlock before setBadBlock completes, causing C to be accepted despite having an invalid parent.
